messages:
maya (platform): quick callout: internal transport decision needed. REST/JSON vs gRPC/protobuf — must consider routing policies, quota propagation, telemetry, and canary UX.
chris (infra): prefer gRPC internally for perf and streaming. gateway/transcoder for browser.
janet (console): gateway is fine but telemetry must keep tenant/route headers. we need transport dimension in dashboards.
ryan (sre): agree. enforcement: gateway for coarse quotas, services for fine-grained checks. add alerts if transcoding adds latency.
priya (api): proto-first is nice for codegen. define header contract: x-rw-tenant, x-rw-route, x-rw-quota-key, x-rw-trace.
alan (sdk): SDKs will generate both surfaces. also auto-create curl/js examples for docs.
ci-bot: RFC lint: missing quota header in example proto.
priya (api): will update RFC draft with header whitelist, error mapping, and test harness.
maya (platform): tentative decision: gRPC/proto internal; managed transcoding gateway for external. RFC due EOD tomorrow. :rocket:
